name: show_changes
description: Summarize recorded session mutations or use `mode=history` for a paged timeline. `changed_files` counts mutation groups; `changed_paths` also lists Git inventory paths when enabled. Only `path` filters Git inventory. Time, sequence, turn, and task filters apply only to mutation records and suppress the Git diff fallback. Git inventory describes the current workspace, not evidence within a time window. Command checks cover the recorded command scope, not semantic correctness; use `verification_details` for provenance and evidence locators.

path.description: Optional entry-level substring filter over recorded mutation paths. It also filters the summary, patch, changed_files, and Git inventory.

since_seq.description: Inclusive lower bound on mutation seq (the persistent mutation version). Combine with until_seq for a closed range.

until_seq.description: Inclusive upper bound on mutation seq.

since.description: Inclusive lower time bound for recorded mutations: RFC3339, YYYY-MM-DD (UTC midnight), or a relative duration ago such as 30m, 2h, 1d, or 1w.

until.description: Inclusive upper time bound for recorded mutations, using the same forms as `since`.

turn_id.description: Only mutations recorded for this turn id.

task_id.description: Only mutations recorded for this task id.

mode.description: `summary` (default) renders the net windowed change summary; `history` returns a per-mutation timeline with seq, timestamp, provenance, per-file version, and diff.

after_seq.description: History cursor: return mutations whose seq is greater than this value. Use history_page.next_after_seq for the next page.

history_limit.description: Maximum history entries per page (default 20; values are clamped to 1..=100).

history_diff_lines.description: Maximum diff lines per history entry (default 20; 0 omits diffs; values are clamped to 0..=100).

include_git.description: When true (default), include Git inventory. The Git diff fallback is used only when the session mutation log is empty. Time/seq/provenance filters suppress it; a path-only filter still applies to the Git inventory and fallback by substring. With a time/seq filter, Git paths are marked by coverage.git_scope and are not time-filtered.

limit_snippet.description: Maximum characters of the rendered text, in units of 80 characters (default 120 means 9600 characters; 0 disables this truncation, but the summary is still capped at 14,000 characters and the Git fallback at 32,768 diff bytes).

verification_details.description: Include whole latest command observations with revision coverage, status, origin/poll call IDs and evidence locators (default false). Defaults to 8 checks and 8192 bytes per page; checks_page reports shown/total counts and the next page.

verification_offset.description: Start at this latest-check index when verification_details is true (default 0). Pagination uses the current committed snapshot; verify revision and observation IDs if commands or mutations run between pages.

verification_limit.description: Maximum whole verification checks per page (default 8; 0 disables the count cap).

verification_max_bytes.description: Maximum pretty-printed verification.checks array bytes per page (default 8192; 0 disables the byte cap). Nonzero budgets are normalized to fit the empty array. An oversized next observation is omitted whole, with next_check_bytes and a hint to lift this cap.

verification_full.description: Return all latest verification checks from the current committed snapshot, enabling details and ignoring offset/count/byte caps (default false).
